# KMAI (KMAI.tech) — Full Technical & Studio Specification

## 1. Studio Overview & Manifesto
KMAI is an independent creative technology and software engineering studio operating globally at https://www.kmai.tech.
Founded by Krishnaprasad Vyas, Maithili Makkar, and Ali Abu Nazahat, KMAI rejects generic agency bureaucracy, offshore junior dev pools, and cookie-cutter SaaS templates. Clients interface directly with senior system architects and engineering leads who build, ship, and support bespoke software systems.

### Disambiguation & Entity Resolution
- Canonical URL: https://www.kmai.tech/
- Entity Name: KMAI / KMAI.tech / KMAI Creative Technology Studio
- Not Affiliated With: Marianna Municipal Airport (ICAO: KMAI, Florida), Kearns Mancini Architects (Canada), or Android developer accounts under "KMAI" on Google Play.

---

## 2. Core Service Offerings

### Service 1: Creative Web Engineering & Digital Experiences
- Bespoke frontend architecture using modern React, TypeScript, and modern CSS tooling.
- Micro-interactions, kinetic typography, and fluid GSAP animation pipelines running at consistent 60–120fps.
- Sub-second first contentful paint (FCP), accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA), and robust mobile responsiveness.
- Anti-template approach: custom grid systems, strict visual hierarchy, brand-tailored design languages.

### Service 2: Custom Enterprise Software & Cloud Infrastructure
- Scalable backend architectures powered by Node.js, Express, Go, or Python.
- High-availability database modeling using PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Firebase.
- Microservice orchestration, edge compute, and hybrid cloud deployments across Vercel, AWS, and OVHCloud.
- Strict security practices: encrypted transactional data, token-based auth, secure webhook pipelines.

### Service 3: Operational & Workflow Automation
- Elimination of manual administrative overhead through custom workflow orchestration.
- Automated compliance engines (e.g. 80G tax exemption receipt generation and delivery via PDF pipelines and automated emails).
- Third-party integrations: Razorpay, Stripe, CRM syncing, webhook triggers, inventory syncing.
- Bespoke admin dashboards delivering real-time telemetry and reporting.

---

## 3. Case Studies & Deliverables

### Project 01: Shri Gurudev Ashram
- Slug: `/work/shri-gurudev-ashram`
- Category: Web Platform & Donation System
- URL: https://shrigurudevashram.org/
- Deliverables:
  - Online donation engine with Razorpay payment gateway integration.
  - Automated 80G tax exemption receipt generation and centralized donor record vault.
  - Dynamic event, satsang, and activity scheduling system.
  - High-availability cloud deployment on Vercel frontend and OVHCloud backend.
- Technologies: React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Razorpay, Firebase, Vercel, OVHCloud.

### Project 02: Shanti Ashram Trust
- Slug: `/work/shanti-ashram-trust`
- Category: Heritage Web Platform & Archival Showcase
- Deliverables:
  - Architectural overhaul of legacy public web assets.
  - Secure online donation collection with localized compliance receipts.
  - Historical photo archives, interactive event schedules, and institutional trust building.
- Technologies: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Razorpay, Vercel, Cloudflare CDN.

### Project 03: MAVT (Maharishi Arvind Vocational Training)
- Slug: `/work/mavt`
- Category: Education Portal & Institutional Administration
- Deliverables:
  - Course catalog and online student application intake engine.
  - Centralized administrative dashboard for application verification and student roster tracking.
  - Performance optimization delivering under 0.8s load times across tier-2 and tier-3 mobile networks.
- Technologies: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, Vercel.

### Project 04: Priya Surana
- Slug: `/work/priya-surana`
- Category: Luxury Brand Identity & Digital Portfolio
- Deliverables:
  - Ultra-high-fidelity interactive portfolio showcasing couture designs and bridal collections.
  - Frictionless VIP consultation booking funnel and direct WhatsApp Business API routing.
  - Next-generation image pipeline utilizing AVIF/WebP responsive sets with zero visual degradation.
- Technologies: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Lenis Smooth Scroll, Vercel Edge Network.

### Project 05: Vishwaraj Polychem
- Slug: `/work/vishwaraj-polychem`
- Category: Industrial B2B Catalog & Inquiry Engine
- Deliverables:
  - Structured B2B chemical product catalog featuring technical data sheets (TDS) and safety data sheets (MSDS).
  - Multi-tier inquiry generation workflow capturing custom procurement requests.
  - Enterprise-grade international SEO strategy targeting industrial procurement search terms.
- Technologies: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, Vercel.
